For a 50-person Indian company, I’d make the shortlist Yatra for Business, MakeMyTrip myBiz, and EaseMyTrip EMTDesk. I would not choose purely on advertised airfare because corporate service fees and change/cancellation handling can materially change the total cost.

Purchase-ready shortlist
Option	Cost / terms to verify	Cancellation / support	Best fit
Yatra for Business	Custom quote. Travel Pro covers companies under ₹5 crore annual travel spend; negotiated fares and GST invoices available. 
Yatra.com
	Free rescheduling on eligible corporate fares; ask for exact cancellation markup and 24/7 escalation terms	50-person company wanting managed corporate controls
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Custom service fee; 1.5% payment-gateway fee can apply to wallet/credit repayments. 
MakeMyTrip
	Special fares advertise free date change/cancellation; ordinary bookings remain subject to airline rules. 
MakeMyTrip Biz
+1
	Lowest-friction rollout + strong expense/GST tooling
EaseMyTrip EMTDesk	Custom corporate quote; get transaction/service fee in writing	24/7 corporate support; cancellation generally follows supplier rules plus applicable service charges	Hands-on managed travel desk
My purchase sequence

1. Get Yatra's Travel Pro quote first. Its published segmentation maps particularly well to a 50-person company, and negotiated fares + policy controls are explicitly included. 
Yatra.com

2. Benchmark it against myBiz. MakeMyTrip publishes enough terms to model the actual cost, including the 1.5% payment fee. 
MakeMyTrip

3. Use EMTDesk as the service-heavy alternative.

Before paying, require each vendor to quote: per-booking/service fee, payment fee, cancellation fee, rescheduling fee, refund SLA, credit period, GST treatment, 24/7 support SLA, and implementation fee. Also ask for a worked example on ₹10 lakh annual travel spend.
